body: -- Founder: 'add fox 3 --tag outer-space fifos the tag subject combo to the top of the queue and starts on that (force or not force) but the other 2 gens get added end of queue same as always.' New prependQueue() puts --tag-forced items ahead of everything already pending. parseAddPositionalArgs adds a subject-with-no-count shape for --tag, defaulting count to 1. 11 new tests. Commit 73421bb.
title: PromptOVerse: --tag forced items jump to front of queue
